subject.title: feat(ui): complete Control UI MCP App bridge

question: After all host command syntaxes are rejected, should fresh authorized MCP App views be allowed to request exact-consent plain-text sends through the normal Control UI chat path?
rationale: The implementation can mechanically enforce the plain-text claim, but accepting sandbox-originated send requests remains a product security choice that tests cannot decide.

options.title: Approve after command fix
options.body: Allow exact-consent text sends only for fresh authorized and interactable views after canonical command rejection is enforced.

options.title: Keep apps read-only
options.body: Reject app-initiated chat sends and land only the read-only reconstruction and live host-context improvements.

recommendation.title: Approve after command fix
recommendation.body: Allow exact-consent text sends only for fresh authorized and interactable views after canonical command rejection is enforced.

likelyOwner.reason: An independent product and security owner should accept the new sandbox-to-chat capability rather than the branch implementer alone.
